context_and_flow.ux_intent: To persuade the user to begin a setup/personalization flow by highlighting ease of use.
ux_patterns: The hero illustration is central and serves to visually reinforce the health and lifestyle focus of the app.
The color palette is cohesive with the Flo brand (pinks and neutrals).
The CTA button uses a high-contrast pink background to draw attention.
The typography is sans-serif, clean, and legible.
